reason: This plugin is primarily an automation utility for DeepSeek Harness that automatically adjusts GPT-family tool-call arguments before execution, specifically stripping redundant sandbox permission fields to satisfy DSH strict escalation rules while keeping true escalations intact. The user-facing purpose is to reduce failed sandbox checks and simplify permission handling during tool invocation, with model matching and behavior controlled by plugin configuration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在 GPT 系列模型的工具调用前自动清理不必要的 sandbox_permissions/justification 字段，并保留真正更高权限的升级请求以减少调用失败。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically removes redundant sandbox_permissions and justification fields from GPT-family tool calls before execution while preserving true permission escalations.

reasons.code: Plugin wraps tool execution to clone and rewrite arguments, removing sandbox_permissions/justification for GPT-family models when not strictly wider than current session.

Behavior matrix shows real permission escalations (for example workspace-write to danger-full-access) are preserved while equal-or-narrower modes are stripped, so incorrect matching could suppress intended fields.
Package manifest indicates peer dependency on DeepSeek Cordis only, with no declared external service/runtime dependency declarations.
